topic: 2h23m a day — a third of your online life inside the retention loop

drafts.text: 2h23m a day. That's the average daily scroll time, over a third of your online life, per datareportal.com. Retention loop doesn't sell, so we call it culture. My next plate's called Retention Loop, still simmering, coming to the menu soon. https://data-snack.com
